verdict.rationale: Inngest's versioning docs say you can deploy changes to functions without explicit version markers or complex migration logic. Step memoization, which checkpoints results and resumes from the last successful step, implies in-flight runs can survive code changes. However, the pack never says in-flight runs keep running on the version they started with, and never explains how determinism is preserved when steps are added, removed or reordered. missing for 10: explicit evidence that in-flight runs complete on their original code version, documented handling of step changes and determinism on redeploy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
